scope: A deterministic 43-day parent has an open CAL24 PM lifecycle at the h1032 cutoff; an otherwise identical half-hour continuation tests its resolution at that boundary, including native report-boundary averaging.

excluded_diagnostic.reason: The native event resolution passed, but the frozen exact-prefix and exact-zero added-bin hypotheses failed: one preterminal downtime row was retrospectively updated and the new half-hour averages retain a small boundary smear.

frozen_parent_observation: Both accepted F04.var01 runs show system CAL24 PM task 533 on aircraft 6 starting at h1031, booking BASE-02 P-MAINT, planned one-hour work.
Neither parent event log records task 533 completion before the h1032 cutoff; the terminal [1031.5,1032) System bin reports seven ready aircraft and one in PM.
The parent establishes an open lifecycle at the cutoff. Its planned completion equals h1032, so positive residual work after the cutoff is not established.
acceptance_hypotheses: A guarded session-0 SSH native run converts without errors or unreviewed warnings, completes import/export/calc/report, roundtrips all authored populated tables exactly, preserves GUI PID13340 and seals raw artifacts.

All event-log bytes after the two-line header and before the first h1032 event equal the accepted parent. The continued run logs task 533 completion, BASE-02 P-MAINT release and aircraft 6 ready at h1032; the accepted parent does not log completion by its cutoff.

The 2064 parent-prefix Stock and Resource time-series rows equal exactly. System rows equal except the [1031,1031.5) row's SYDT/NSYDT finalized downtime counters; all other fields and rows equal. The continued report appends one [1032,1032.5) bin.

The added bin has near-eight ready aircraft and near-zero PM/resource occupancy: NSYRY between 7.99 and 8, NSYPM and NRUM between 0 and 0.01. Native event log, rather than exact bin zero, establishes task completion at the boundary.

Mission counts, no-failure/no-backorder stock behavior and the original two-base schedule remain unchanged; ResultSummary differs only in its upper time bound, with resource totals interpreted using the longer denominator.
limitations: This is one deterministic CAL24 PM at a horizon boundary, not a general unfinished-task law.

The parent does not prove positive remaining PM duration at h1032; continuation establishes resolution ordering at the boundary. Report bins can show small time-sampling smear and a retrospectively finalized downtime counter.
Unfinished repair, transit, reserved stock, alternate seeds, GUI visuals and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
